Following the [[Jedi Civil War]], legendary [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]] were [[Marriage/Legends|married]]. The groom had a hangover the following morning as a result of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] consumption. The '''wedding''' was only approved by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] on the condition that Revan agreed not to spread his new-found philosophy of love, which they viewed as heresy, to the rest of the Order.

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', it was revealed that Revan and Bastila Shan had married after the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]], and while it was also noted that they resided on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after their union, where they were married was not stated.
